prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose game-character source sheet for review
Primary request: Create one cohesive rounded full-body pixel-art sheet for the ordinary clinic patient in everyday civilian clothes in Image2. Image1 controls only accepted v6a/v6b pixel-art style, proportional scale and eight-pose layout. Image2 controls every identity/outfit detail: a 88-year-old adult man with deep dark-brown skin, wispy straight white hair with a broad bald crown and a swept side fringe, a clean-shaven face and no glasses, and a slim build. They wear a forest-green full-sleeved cardigan over a muted-coral button shirt, cream trousers and chestnut lace-up shoes. All sleeves are full length to the wrists. No badge, lanyard, scrubs or white coat. Preserve every detail across all eight views.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows and four isolated full-body figures. Top left-to-right: standing SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Bottom same order: seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Broad transparent gutters and generous row gap; every head and shoe fully visible and well away from canvas edges. Seated figures sit on invisible chairs, knees bent around90degrees, hands naturally on thighs, feet flat; no chair visible. Same head/body scale and proportions in standing and seated views. All eight figures, INCLUDING the bottom-right seated NORTH/rear figure, have full-length sleeves to the wrists, with BOTH elbows and forearms fully covered in sleeve fabric and only hands showing skin. Sleeves remain full-length to wrists; outfit layers and garment hems rest naturally while seated.
Style/medium: soft rounded high-quality pixel art matching Image1, compact friendly proportions, crisp dark pixel-stepped outlines and softly textured shading.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background; no hat, equipment, held props, chair, furniture, floor, shadow, glow, scenery, logo, text, readable badge, watermark, labels, grid, duplicate/missing/cropped pose.

Age and dignity: this is visibly a 88-year-old older adult, not a young person with recolored hair. Preserve the accepted rounded game proportions and large eyes, while using subtle crow's-feet, gentle cheek and mouth lines, age-appropriate hair density, and a gently forward but balanced relaxed posture. Warm, capable, calm expression; no caricature, frailty stereotype or exaggerated wrinkles. Appearance and accessories have no diagnostic meaning.
No eyeglasses in any view. Keep the specified hair silhouette, not the reference's gray curls; do not copy its rose cardigan, sage trousers or identity.
